verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party webhooks documentation says the webhooks journal API lets third-party integrators subscribe to real-time events, retrieve historical event data, and manage CRM object snapshots. That covers the core of event subscription via webhooks. The evidence is a single short snippet, and the 'journal' framing leaves the outbound push-delivery mechanics only implied. Missing for 10: documented event types and subscription registration flow, delivery/retry and signature-verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
